description: A plan for walking, cycling and rolling: the network that exists, the network people need, and the order in which the gaps get closed.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the kickoff date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.

It assumes the agency is leading the plan with its own staff or a consultant already on board, so the first offsets are short. A plan that starts with procurement needs those milestones added at the front.

No jurisdiction is assumed. Review periods, required notices, hearings and the body that adopts the work are set where you are; none of them are stated here. Add the records your own process requires.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Work plan and engagement strategy
deliverables.summary: The task list, the schedule, and how the agency will reach people who do not attend meetings.

deliverables.title: Existing network and conditions inventory
deliverables.summary: Sidewalks, crossings, bikeways, trails, lighting and the barriers between them — including the gaps, which are the point.

deliverables.title: Demand and priority analysis
deliverables.summary: Where short trips already happen, where people are underserved, and where the network would carry the most people if it existed.

deliverables.title: First-round engagement summary
deliverables.summary: What people said and where they said it, including mapped public input, before any network is drawn.

deliverables.title: Draft network recommendations and facility types
deliverables.summary: The proposed network with a facility type for each segment and the reasoning behind each choice.

deliverables.title: Draft active transportation plan
deliverables.summary: The complete draft assembled for public review.

deliverables.title: Final active transportation plan
deliverables.summary: The draft revised after review, with the comment record attached.

deliverables.title: Prioritized project list and implementation program
deliverables.summary: The projects in delivery order, with the maintenance and design work each one implies.

milestones.title: Project kickoff meeting
milestones.summary: Scope, schedule and the engagement approach confirmed with the team.

milestones.title: Community events and pop-up outreach complete
milestones.summary: Outreach taken to where people already are, not only to a meeting room.

milestones.title: Open house on the draft network
milestones.summary: The proposed network shown publicly while it can still change.

milestones.title: Public review of the draft plan opens
milestones.summary: The draft is released for comment.

milestones.title: Adoption of the plan
milestones.summary: Adoption by the body with authority over the network.
